text:
maria: quick heads-up: ran the on‑prem token-scheduler + kv-evict pass on the small-GPU pool (slice-3). seeing latency spikes around the 512-token boundary, looks like batch formation jitter + kv ejection hammering the queue :eyes:

ajohnson: can you paste the config & the perf summary? curious if target token budget or the queue policy flipped during the run

maria: pasted the exact override I used for the job:
```yaml
deployment: onprem-slice-3
queue_policy: weighted_rr
target_token_budget: 1024
kv_evict_threshold: 0.62
max_batch_delay_ms: 12
kernel_pref: auto
```

perf-bot: profiling snapshot (top lines):
```
[prof] avg_latency_p95: 240ms -> spikes to 680ms at seq=512
[prof] batch_size_mean: 6.2  batch_size_var: 3.8
[prof] kv_evict_rate: 18/s during spikes
[prof] kernel_switches: 0->1 at spike start (auto kernel fallback)
```

samir: that kv_evict_rate looks high. on constrained RAM slices the eviction loop can cause a short-term CPU+io stall which blocks batch formation. try lowering `target_token_budget` and increase `max_batch_delay_ms` slightly so we favor batching over immediate eviction. also maybe use `queue_policy: latency_first` for now. @kai wdyt?

kai: ran a quick A/B on slice-3 with two configs: control (what maria ran) vs tweak:
```yaml
# tweak
queue_policy: latency_first
target_token_budget: 768
kv_evict_threshold: 0.7
max_batch_delay_ms: 18
```
results over 1h: p95 went from 240ms -> 170ms, spike count dropped by ~78%, throughput -3%. cost per token slightly up but latency much smoother.

maria: interesting — this matches the regression I reported vs master. with the auto kernel selection the runtime was switching kernels mid-request when eviction kicked in, which explains the big spike (kernel_switches line). we should avoid kernel switches during active batches if possible :shrug:

ajohnson: try forcing kernel_pref: "fallback_stable" for the canary run. that prevents mid-token kernel swaps. also add a small jitter to eviction timing to avoid synchronized ejection across workers: `kv_evict_jitter_ms: 20`

ops-bot: deploy note: created canary job on slice-3 with tweak config (target_token_budget=768, queue_policy=latency_first). canary id: canary-20240308-56. will run for 2h and roll if p95 < 200ms and spike-rate < 10/hr.

maria: ack — i'll monitor logs and the kernel_switch trace. if canary passes we'll propagate the tweak to the private defaults and add a test to prevent kernel switching during kv_eviction cycles :thumbsup:
